name: io.github.dubaikseniia-wq/entra-mcp
title: ENTRA Jobs
description: Verified AI/tech jobs from company ATSs: search, fit matching, salary stats; employer job posting

environmentVariables.name: ENTRA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Employer API key (entra_live_…) from https://entracareers.com/employer/profile?tab=api-keys — enables employer tools

environmentVariables.name: ENTRA_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the ENTRA API base URL (default https://entracareers.com/api)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional — employer mode. Value "Bearer entra_live_…" with a key from https://entracareers.com/employer/profile?tab=api-keys. Omit for candidate tools.
